msg: library unisim: Xilinx primitives ship with Vivado, not with GHDL. Compile them once with GHDL's vendor script compile-xilinx-vivado.sh (libraries/vendors) against your Vivado install and pass -P<dir>, or replace the primitive with generic RTL.

library xpm: Xilinx Parameterized Macros are SystemVerilog source; the VHDL package only declares components. GHDL simulates VHDL only, so an XPM instance has no model. Replace it with an inferred VHDL FIFO/RAM or a behavioural model for simulation.
library unimacro: another Vivado-only library. Compile it with compile-xilinx-vivado.sh like UNISIM, or replace the macro with generic RTL.
library secureip: encrypted hard-IP models that only Vivado's simulator can decrypt. GHDL cannot load them; stub the block with a behavioural model in the testbench.
std_logic_arith / std_logic_unsigned / std_logic_signed are Synopsys packages, not IEEE. GHDL analyses them only with -fsynopsys. Better fix: use ieee.numeric_std.all and unsigned()/signed() casts.
process(all) is VHDL-2008. GHDL's default standard is 93c, so analysis fails unless every ghdl -a / -e / -r call gets --std=08.
Matching operators (?=, ?/=, ?<, ...) are VHDL-2008. Pass --std=08 to GHDL.
std.env (stop/finish) is VHDL-2008. Pass --std=08 to GHDL, or end a VHDL-93 testbench with an assert ... severity failure.
Context references are VHDL-2008. Pass --std=08 to GHDL (VUnit and OSVVM contexts need it too).
to_string / to_hstring / to_ostring are VHDL-2008 functions. Pass --std=08 to GHDL.

A shared variable of a plain type is legal in VHDL-93 only. This file needs --std=08, and there GHDL stops with an error: the type must be protected. Wrap it in a protected type, or pass -frelaxed to downgrade it to a warning.
IEEE 1735 protected envelope: this block is encrypted for vendor simulators. GHDL cannot decrypt it; ask the IP vendor for a plain behavioural model or stub the block.
